official_title: Proposal for a Regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act) and amending certain Union legislative acts – General approach
version_label: Text submitted to Council for general approach

institution_roles.evidence_locator: Cover: From Permanent Representatives Committee (Part 1) to Council; section III paragraph 2 states the Czech Presidency prepared the final text and Coreper agreed to submit it without changes.
Release header and opening: on 6 December 2022 the Council adopted its common position ('general approach'); the resource list directly links ST 14954/22 as 'General approach'.

corpus_assessment.inclusion_rationale: Final Coreper-submitted Council text subsequently adopted as the Council's common position on the AI Act.
corpus_assessment.researcher_notes: The cover and body preserve the exact Coreper I/Czech Presidency preparation roles; the Council's 6 December adoption is separately evidenced. ST 15698/22 remains the distinct outcome-of-proceedings record.

document_date.meaning: The official PDF establishes 25 November 2022 as the issue date of this text.

publication_date.locator: Release header: 6 December 2022 10:20; direct resource link 'General approach'.
publication_date.meaning: The dated official Council release directly publishes ST 14954/22 on 6 December 2022, establishing the primary manifestation publication date under scope specification section 5.1.

classification_evidence.locator: Section IV headings and paragraphs 1-7; Annex title and Articles 1-85.
classification_evidence.rationale: The text directly defines and regulates AI systems, prohibited practices, high-risk systems, general-purpose AI, governance, enforcement and innovation.

classification_evidence.locator: Section IV paragraphs 1-7 and Annex recital 5a on a horizontal framework applying across sectors.
classification_evidence.rationale: The proposed AI Act supplies a horizontal framework spanning product safety, data protection, financial services, law enforcement, public authorities and other sectors.

classification_evidence.locator: Cover From Coreper I to Council; section III paragraph 2 attributes preparation to the Czech Presidency and approval for submission to Coreper.
classification_evidence.rationale: The exact Council preparatory bodies and Presidency drafting responsibility are identified in the official document.

classification_evidence.locator: Dated Council release and direct 'General approach' link to ST 14954/22.
classification_evidence.rationale: An official dated Council publication directly links this exact manifestation.

additional_dates.locator: Opening sentence: the Council has adopted its common position ('general approach'); header 6 December 2022 10:20.
